name: Historic District of Old Québec
description: Perched on a cliff above the St. Lawrence River in Quebec City, Canada, Old Québec was founded by Samuel de Champlain in the early 1600s. It is the only city in North America that still has its fortification walls, along with bastions and gates. You can wander from the clifftop Upper Town, home to the Citadel and the turreted Château Frontenac, down to the old streets of the Lower Town.
